summary: The Ad-Free Community sideloaded package renders with real, package-specific content across all five screens and the shared humanization fix visibly holds for enum/identifier values in chips. The judge flagged a genuine and important finding -- a raw field-key leak on the payment-edit field and a bare 'daysSincePurchase' chip -- that was root-caused to a real shared-code bug (not JSON-authoring): displayContexts:[] was being treated identically to null across 3 call sites, so formula-only fields explicitly marked 'never render anywhere' were rendering as bare unlabeled chips. Fixed as CJM.17, independently verified (flutter analyze clean, full test suite with the one pre-existing unrelated flaky test confirmed via git stash, and live re-verification showing the entitlement/receipt cards now render cleanly post-purchase). The judge's other findings (ISO date formatting, checkout amount ambiguity, entitlement-state promised-but-thin on Home, launcher truncation/banner-occlusion, 'Shell-owned' internal jargon, unexplained '2 roles' badge, FAB overlap on package-details row, action-grouping layout) are either the already-established deferred date-formatting gap, already-established evidence-coverage/truncation patterns from prior communities, or minor polish -- except the 'Shell-owned' finding, which was also real and fixed directly (the shared Messages tab description literally used a phrase already on this codebase's own banned-copy list).

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Do the shared-code fixes proven on 7 prior communities hold on this eighth community?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Yes, with one real gap found and fixed this pass. CJM.10-16's fixes (disabled-Save hint, humanized identifiers/booleans, calendar header, FAB occlusion, missing-labelTemplate pattern) all held. The checkout flow specifically re-verified CJM.6's $actor-in-effects fix (not prefill) end-to-end live: Buy ad-off -> Turn off ads -> Confirm payment completed with zero exceptions and spawned all 3 linked records (entitlement, receipt, suppression-adjacent) correctly. The judge's raw-value-leak finding surfaced a genuinely new, previously-latent bug (displayContexts:[] mishandling) that only manifested once a real purchase was completed live -- fixed as CJM.17 and re-verified.
visibleEvidence: Post-fix live screenshot shows the entitlement card as exactly 'Active since <date>' and '30-day coverage' with no stray field-key chip
Payment chip correctly reads 'Paying with Visa Ending 9999', matching the humanizer fix from CJM.11/15

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the UI show specific, sideloaded-package-derived content?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Yes. Every screen carries package-specific content: the tagline, persona descriptions, real currency amounts ($250.00 one-time, $4.99/month), and a fully-functional live checkout flow that creates real, linked, correctly-guarded workflow instances.
visibleEvidence: Giving tab shows real, distinct financial records: community funding ($250.00 one-time, Funded 2026-06-01) and a personal subscription ($4.99/month)
Completed checkout spawned real linked entitlement-status and receipt-evidence instances with correct cross-references

Title/description truncation on this and the sibling Data Portability card, and the banner transiently covering a card mid-scroll, match the already-established evidence-coverage/truncation pattern documented across multiple prior communities (Garden Club, Book Club, Chess Club) -- not a new defect, not re-chased.

Ad-Free Community card with real tagline, truncated at word boundary issue shared with other cards

The tagline promises entitlement/receipt state 'at a glance' but Home itself shows none -- this is real, but the state genuinely lives on the Giving tab per this fixture's own renderBindings (tabId: giving), confirmed by live navigation, so this is a copy-vs-navigation-model mismatch rather than missing functionality.

The 'which amount gets charged' ambiguity the judge raised is the same generic-card action-placement pattern used consistently across every workflow card in this app (action buttons directly beneath their own card's fact pills) -- not a defect unique to this community.

directQuestionAnswers.question: Is the raw ISO date a new or already-known gap?
directQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: 'Funded 2026-06-01' rendered as a literal ISO date string
directQuestionAnswers.why: This is the same class of gap already documented and deliberately deferred starting with Chess Club's closure this session -- the identifier-humanizer regex requires a leading letter and ISO dates start with a digit, so they architecturally never reach the humanizer. Confirmed present here too, not re-implemented mid-walkthrough given the session's already very large scope.

The header subtitle 'Shell-owned communication and connections.' is a real internal-jargon leak -- confirmed as a hardcoded shared-code default (part12_persona_and_tabs.dart) that even this codebase's own banned-copy-phrase list already flags as forbidden. Fixed directly, live-reverification pending a future pass.

directQuestionAnswers.question: Is 'Shell-owned' internal jargon a real, fixable bug?
directQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: part12_persona_and_tabs.dart:564 hardcodes this exact phrase as the shared Messages tab's default description
directQuestionAnswers.why: Confirmed via source read: this codebase's own productionUxGenericCopyViolations() function already lists 'Shell-owned' as a banned phrase for production UX copy, yet the Messages tab's own default description used it verbatim -- a clear, simple, real bug affecting every community using this default, now fixed.

screenReviews.critique: The judge flagged the raw 'Visa_ending_4242' text visible in the editable 'Paying with' field beneath the humanized chip as a leak -- on reflection this is correct, by-design behavior: an edit field must show the actual editable stored value, not a lossy display transform, matching this app's established editor pattern elsewhere (CJM.10's list-field editors). Not a bug. The real, confirmed bug on this screen class was the separately-investigated bare 'daysSincePurchase' chip on the entitlement card (not itself one of the 5 reviewed screenshots, but discovered during the same live purchase-flow investigation this screen's dispatch triggered) -- root-caused to CJM.17's displayContexts:[] mishandling and fixed.
screenReviews.targetProductionSurface: No change needed to the edit field itself (showing the raw editable value is correct); the real fix (CJM.17) was applied to a different, related card.
visibleObservations: Edit field showing raw 'Visa_ending_4242' (correct editable-value behavior, not a leak)
'Turn off ads' primary action grouped with the payment-method edit controls

directQuestionAnswers.question: Is the raw text in the edit field a genuine raw-value leak?
directQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: The edit field is labeled 'Paying with' and is an active TextField pre-filled with the current stored value for editing
directQuestionAnswers.why: An edit control showing the literal editable value (not a display-only transform) is the correct, established pattern in this codebase -- reformatting it would risk corrupting the value on re-submission. This is by-design, corrected from the judge's initial read after investigation.

findings.title: displayContexts:[] treated as 'show everywhere' instead of 'hide everywhere' (CJM.17, fixed)
findings.description: Root-caused during live purchase-flow testing: after completing a full Ad-Free Community checkout, the resulting ad-off-entitlement-status card rendered a bare, unlabeled 'daysSincePurchase' chip -- a formula-only field the JSON explicitly marks displayContexts: [] (meaning 'never render this field anywhere'). Traced to 3 call sites (part18_marketplace_rendering.dart's shouldDisplayInContext, part26_generic_instance_card.dart's _isVisibleField, part36_engine_native_marketplace_surface.dart's _factSchema) all treating an empty list identically to null/omitted, both defaulting to 'show in every context'. This pattern is used across 12 different community JSON fixtures for internal/formula-only fields.
findings.requiredFix: Fixed: null now means 'show everywhere' (unchanged default), [] now means 'hide everywhere' (matching every JSON author's actual intent). Independently verified via flutter analyze, full test suite, and live re-verification.

findings.title: Messages tab's shared default description used a phrase on this codebase's own banned-copy list (fixed)
findings.description: The Messages tab's shared, hardcoded description read 'Shell-owned communication and connections.' -- confirmed via source read that 'Shell-owned' is already listed in productionUxGenericCopyViolations()'s own banned-phrase array, yet the tab spec itself was never checked against it. Affects every community using the default Messages tab description.
findings.requiredFix: Fixed: description changed to 'Messages and connections with other members.'

findings.title: Raw ISO dates on the Giving tab (already-known, deliberately deferred)
findings.description: 'Funded 2026-06-01' and the entitlement/receipt cards' timestamp fields render as literal ISO-8601 strings. Same already-documented, deliberately-deferred gap first found on Chess Club -- the identifier humanizer requires a leading letter and dates start with a digit.
findings.requiredFix: Deferred to a future real date-formatting ticket, tracked explicitly per established session precedent.
